name: Secrets apply (read pending secret envelopes, prove them, write them to the boxes)

knobs.note: BH-7965: how many pending envelopes one tick lists (GET /api/secrets/envelope?state=pending&limit=), read as ${SECRETS_APPLY_BATCH:-20}. A value outside 1..100 is one ALERTS line and no tick.
BH-7965: the ssh ConnectTimeout bin/envelope-consume.sh uses per box, read as ${SECRETS_APPLY_SSH_TIMEOUT_S:-15}. A value outside 3..120 is one ALERTS line and no tick.
BH-7965: the time one vendor proof call (bin/lib/vendor/<v>.sh probe) may take, read as ${SECRETS_APPLY_PROBE_TIMEOUT_S:-30}. A value outside 5..300 is one ALERTS line and no tick.
BH-7965: at most one 'pending envelopes and no hub key' ALERTS line per this many seconds, read as ${SECRETS_APPLY_ALERT_WINDOW_S:-3600}. A value outside 300..86400 is one ALERTS line and no tick.
BH-7965: the hub's private envelope key, read as ${ENVELOPE_KEY:-/etc/harness/envelope.key}. A path a root lane reads a private key from: NOT settable from the control plane.
BH-7965 test seam: epoch seconds the rotated-key age is measured from, read as ${ENVELOPE_NOW:-<date +%s>}. NOT settable from the control plane.
